description: Who is this address? From operator address registries (Aave, Morpho, Spark, Grove, Sky, Euler, Compound, Fluid, Pendle, Yearn, Lido, Ethena), our own vault index (a vault holding another vault), the contract’s own on-chain self-description, and explorer tags: label, class (protocol_liquidity, vault, protocol, exchange, custodian, market_maker, treasury, agent), source, date checked and confidence. An address no source names comes back unidentified with its shape (wallet, multisig, contract), never as a person. With vault: the identified holders among its largest. Without either: how much of the largest holders’ capital is named, by class. FREE.

vault.description: A vault slug or id: its named holders.

name: address_identity

identity.description: With address: who it is; null when unidentified or in the vault and summary forms.

summary.description: Without address or vault: counts by source and class; null otherwise.
